marketTypes.title: Market types
marketTypes.description: Which weather markets to read. high_temp and low_temp are the daily temperature brackets; rain covers daily, weekend and monthly rain; snow is monthly snowfall; other is hurricanes, ski-resort openings, climate and the rest (price only, no forecast).

cities.title: Cities
cities.description: Optional. Only these cities, e.g. New York City, Chicago, Miami, Austin, Denver. Empty = every city.

seriesTickers.title: Series tickers
seriesTickers.description: Optional. Exact Kalshi series, e.g. KXHIGHNY, KXLOWTCHI, KXRAINNYCM. Overrides market types and cities.

includeForecast.title: Add forecast probability
includeForecast.description: Adds the share of 82 ensemble forecast members (ECMWF + GFS) that land in each bracket at the settlement station, the edge versus the market, and today's observed high/low. Off = prices only, faster.

onlyTraded.title: Only traded markets
onlyTraded.description: Skip markets with no volume and no open interest.

maxRows.title: Maximum markets
maxRows.description: Stop after this many market rows.
